culprit_citations.quoted_text: Term Loan | First Lien | 3M SOFR+ 6.50% | Cost 9,537,896 | Fair Value 9,537,896

findings.detail: B01 denominator includes issuer header and total rows that are not investment-position leaves; the source position leaves carry fair value and tie to the schedule total.

citation.quoted_text: Archer Systems, LLC issuer header has no position fair value, while its following investment rows do.

rationale: The source SOI tables contain 62 real investment-position rows with fair values and 44 non-position structural rows such as issuer headers and totals. The filing total fair value is 127,382,778 in both the SOI total and investment total tables, and the flag reports residual_fv 0.0. Therefore the 62/106 fair-value coverage failure is caused by B01 counting structural rows in scope, not by missing source fair values.
